description: PranaSetu is an environmental technology project combining security, fire safety, blue carbon and algae-based environmental solutions.

modules.intruder: The intruder system detects unauthorized movement using sensors such as PIR, IR or a camera. When an intrusion is detected, the system can raise an alert.
modules.fire: The fire detection system can use flame and smoke sensors. When dangerous conditions are detected, it raises an emergency alert and can activate protective devices.
modules.blue_carbon: Blue carbon refers to carbon captured and stored by coastal and marine ecosystems such as mangroves, seagrass meadows and salt marshes. These ecosystems store carbon in biomass and sediments.
modules.green_algae_tree: The Green Algae Tree is a conceptual environmental system using algae to absorb carbon dioxide during photosynthesis. The algae use light, water and nutrients to grow while taking up CO2.

faq.what is blue carbon: Blue carbon is carbon captured and stored by coastal and marine ecosystems, especially mangroves, seagrasses and salt marshes.
faq.how does algae reduce co2: Algae perform photosynthesis. They use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into organic matter and release oxygen.
faq.what is the purpose of the project: PranaSetu connects environmental protection, safety and technology into one integrated system.
